newsitem.title: USA: Life sentence in Boston rape-murder of Irish woman.
newsitem.headline: Life sentence in Boston rape-murder of Irish woman.

text.p: A convicted rapist was sentenced on Friday to life in prison after a jury found him guilty of the 1995 rape and murder of an Irish woman.
The jury deliberated less than three hours before finding Pedro Rosario, 28, guilty of the murder and aggravated rape of Orla Benson, 22, outside a social services agency in Boston.
Benson, a Killarney resident and Dublin City University student, had come to Boston for a summer job.

Testimony during the six-day trial revealed that Rosario, who was on parole after a 1991 rape conviction, had met Benson after she left friends while walking back to her apartment in the early hours of Sept. 23, 1995.
Her mutilated body was found later that day on a staircase outside the building where Rosario worked, just 50 yards (metres) from her apartment house.

"It's a pity that there is no death penalty in this state (Massachusetts), for surely this monster (Rosario) deserves it for his acts," Aaron Benson, the dead woman's brother, said in a victim's statement read before the sentence of life in prison without parole was handed down.
